label: owns or is parent of
definition: Person or organization X owns business, organization or property Y, or is its corporate parent.
scope_notes: Preserves ownership/parent scope, allowing personal owners and properties. Officeholding, political association, travel and criminal-case location do not suffice.

facts.reason: Cablevision explicitly owns Madison Square Garden and is its owner.
Meyer is explicitly owner of Union Square Cafe.
Mr. Smith has crime, traffic-stop and charge-location paths in Brooklyn; ownership is not supplied.
Steinbrenner is explicitly Yankees owner and owns them.
Democrats and Hillary Rodham Clinton have campaign/money associations, without ownership.
